# Tighe Logistics

Tighe Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Tighe Logistics is a full service 3rd party logistics company providing asset based warehousing, transportation + value added services in the New England area. Tighe Logistics employs 54 people and has an annual revenue of $10.2M, founded in 1862. Headquartered in Woburn, Massachusetts, United States, with offices in Mansfield, Avon, Winchester, and Methuen. Its workforce is distributed across United States and India.

## About

Tighe Logistics is the leader in warehousing, transportation and third-party logistics in the Greater Boston and New England area. Headquartered in Woburn, MA with a network of warehouses extending across the northeast, we offer a full range of inventory management, temp-controlled storage, cross-docking, food-grade facilities, and value-added services unmatched in the area for 160 years.

What’s more, we offer exceptional transportation solutions for integrated distribution across the region. Leverage our transportation fleet of 50+ power units and 100+ trailers to move your goods to market faster using drayage, JIT shuttles, milk runs, dedicated deliveries, and trained, skilled drivers that only Tighe, as your local, specialized expert, can provide.

# Tighe International

Tighe International is a Outsourcing and Offshoring Consulting company. Tighe International is a company that specializes in hedge fund management. They offer portfolio management, seeding programs, proprietary trading, and family office investment vehicles globally. Tighe International employs 4 people, founded in 2013. Headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with an office in Chesterfield.

## About

Tighe International is a Dubai and London Based Search & Selection firm specialising in Quantitative and Systematic Trading and Portfolio Management. We work with the Major Market Making, Proprietary, Hedge Fund, Investment Banks and Asset Manager firms as well as advising other Executive Search firms in what is our Niche area. Founded in 2013, we aim to determine a strategy to identify the talent your firm requires to maximise profits. Our coverage is Global. We work with consultants in both the US and Asia to determine the best talent for the roles mandated, The key individuals of Tighe Search focus solely upon activities within the systematic trading and quantitative finance industry. We regularly conduct market research for our clients into the activities within the global marketplace for quantitative and systematic strategies and we have an unparalleled track record of retained searches for high frequency and systematic traders. Our aim is to improve on this globally.
